subject: Greenfield Bank — Azure Private Plan: billing model & indemnity language
messages:
From: Alicia Turner <alicia.turner@greenfieldbank.com>
To: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@greenfieldbank.com
Date: Fri, 05 Feb 2027 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Azure private plan – billing cadence & indemnity concerns

Jordan —

Thanks for the quick demo earlier this week. Legal ran the private plan docs and a couple of items popped up on our side:

1) Billing cadence: our treasury team needs monthly consolidated invoices (single invoice for all units) with GL-friendly line items. The standard Marketplace settlement cycle is quarterly which creates a mismatch for our internal reporting. Can Redwood provide a monthly billing option as part of the private plan?

2) Indemnity & data handling: the indemnity clause in Exhibit B looks broad to our counsel (specifically the IP carveouts and the cap language). They asked if Redwood would accept a carveout for customer data processed for the service and a liability cap tied to 12 months' fees.

I've attached excerpts from our SOW and the vendor questionnaire. Happy to hop on a call to align.

Alicia Turner
Head of Procurement | Greenfield Bank
A: 415-555-0198
From: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Turner <alicia.turner@greenfieldbank.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Feb 2027 10:27:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Azure private plan – billing cadence & indemnity concerns

Hi Alicia —

Appreciate the notes and attachments. Quick replies to the two asks before we pull in legal and finance: 

• Monthly billing: We can support monthly invoicing for Dedicated/Private customers, but it requires a billing flow change vs. standard Azure Marketplace settlement. That will need a short commercial amendment and finance + marketplace ops sign-off. Marcus, can you confirm constraints?

• Indemnity cap & data carveout: I'll loop in Laura (legal) — we typically accept a data processing carveout and can discuss a 12-month fee cap for most mid-market customers, subject to exec approval.

Would you be open to a 30-minute call next Tue (9–11 PT) so we can jointly walk our redlines? I’ll bring the legal and marketplace folks.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Alicia Turner <alicia.turner@greenfieldbank.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Feb 2027 08:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Azure private plan – billing cadence & indemnity concerns

Alicia & team —

I reviewed the Exhibit B redlines Alicia provided. High level:

• Data carveout: agreeable in principle. Proposed wording: indemnities shall not apply to Customer Data processed by Redwood under the DPA, except for breach caused by Redwood’s gross negligence or willful misconduct.
• Liability cap: we prefer tiered caps but can accept a flat cap equal to 12 months of fees for this specific private plan opportunity given the enterprise relationship, provided procurement confirms expected ARR/commitment.
• IP carveouts: we will not accept a full IP indemnity that exposes us to claims over third-party models; recommend model-specific IP language.

I’ve attached a marked-up Exhibit B (see Redwood_PrivatePlan_ExhibitB_redlines.pdf). Laura

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Alicia Turner <alicia.turner@greenfieldbank.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Azure private plan – billing cadence & indemnity concerns

Thanks — operational notes from Marketplace side: 

• Monthly billing via Redwood: feasible but requires us to map line items to Marketplace product SKUs; this is an ops change and will add a 2-week lead time for onboarding and invoice template updates.
• Co-sell & revenue split: Microsoft expects a standard co-sell revenue share if we go through the Private Offer/Marketplace route. John Reynolds (MS) should confirm, but typical splits for this channel are locked in by their partner program.
• Procurement artifacts: to expedite, please provide your PO and expected monthly spend profile so finance can model cashflow.

I’ll coordinate with John to confirm whether the monthly invoice can be pushed through platform billing or if we need a parallel direct-bill arrangement.

— Stephanie Nguyen
Marketplace & Partnerships Lead | Redwood Inference
From: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Alicia Turner <alicia.turner@greenfieldbank.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 09:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Azure private plan – billing cadence & indemnity concerns

Alicia —

From a finance perspective: monthly invoicing is workable if Greenfield can accept electronic invoices and the monthly AR reconciliation is performed by your treasury team. We'll need a template showing the GL mapping (three to five line items preferred). 

On the liability cap: if Greenfield's expected yearly spend for the service is under $1M, a 12-month fee cap is acceptable; above that threshold we’ll need exec approval due to potential exposure. Please confirm projected annual contract value.

I’ve attached an invoice template (Azure_Marketplace_Terms_Summary.xlsx) and marked the fields we need filled.

Marcus Lin
Director, Finance | Redwood Inference
From: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Turner <alicia.turner@greenfieldbank.com>, John Reynolds <john.reynolds@microsoft.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 16:48:00 -08:00
Subject: Final: Consolidated redlines & next steps (DocuSign)

Alicia / John —

Thanks for the quick turnaround, everyone. Attached are the consolidated redlines: Redwood_PrivatePlan_ExhibitB_redlines.pdf and Greenfield_SOW_v3.docx. Summary of agreed positions:

• Billing: Redwood can issue monthly consolidated invoices mapped to the provided GL template. Two-week ops lead time for onboarding.
• Indemnity & liability: Redwood will accept a data-processing carveout and a 12-month fee liability cap for this deal, conditional on confirmed ARR <= $1M.
• Marketplace/co-sell: Microsoft to confirm standard revenue share; if Marketplace disallows monthly settlement we’ll execute a dual approach (MS marketplace listing for co-sell + direct monthly invoicing from Redwood).

Next steps:
1) Alicia — please confirm projected annual spend and upload PO + GL mapping to the SharePoint link.
2) John — can you confirm Microsoft’s revenue share and whether monthly settlement is supported on this private plan?
3) Once confirmed, I’ll send a DocuSign package with the amended Exhibit B and SOW.

DocuSign envelope (preview): https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123XYZ
SharePoint draft folder: https://sharepoint.redwood.com/sites/marketplace/Greenfield/terms-drafts

Thanks — talk soon.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
